pages.text: Heating items is a way of converting one item to another, or an item to a fluid. Items can be heated in many ways - in a $(l:craftsmanship/firepit)Firepit$(), a $(l:craftsmanship/pit_kiln)Pit Kiln$(), or a $(l:craftsmanship/charcoal_forge)Charcoal Forge$(), to name a few. However, they all function in the same way. When you place items inside these devices, the items will gradually start to heat up. This is visible on the item's tooltip.
